text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival. A festival 
of sports where fans are welcomed into 
Tracen Academy.

The event Wonder Acute will be taking on 
is—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've done it a little bit 
before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Was the stance... like this? Mmmmmm..."

—Golf, the traditional sport. It was a bit 
surprising to hear she had experience, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? By the way, dear Trainer. Which gate 
are we aiming for?

...I mistook it for gateball. It seems 
golf is out of the question here. In that 
case--

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fuho! That's it, after all. Yes, yes, 
boxing!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Looking closer, though, the name of 
the sport seems a bit different. "Art 
Boxing"?

It's not a fistfight; victory is decided 
by "grace of movement" and "endurance."

And our formidable rivals— had already 
begun competing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, art boxing, huh. I can manage 
something by adapting savate.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hmph, hah hah, hmph!

...Sirius Symboli, who has experience in 
the French martial art of "Savate." And—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I used to incorporate it into my 
body-shaping routine for a while, too.

Gold City, who also works as a model. What 
will the final verdict be—

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
That is all for both of you. Thank you for 
your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Didn't make it to the finals? Why 
not?!

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli-san occasionally mixed in 
kicking motions. As for Gold City-san...

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Between movements, there are deliberate 
glances and signature poses...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just out of habit... It's tough, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
One, two! One, two! Princess☆Face 
Puuunch!!!
(CRASH!)

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess-san, disqualified~. You 
can't literally punch the fence!

—Amidst a drama tangled with all sorts of 
emotions, Wonder Acute steadily fought her 
way up, and now, the finals—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —I'm in your care, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To cross paths with someone who has real 
boxing experience —it truly straightens my 
posture.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, Yaeno-san. Wonderful to see you. 
Your posture is as magnificent as ever~.

"Your opponent is Yaeno Muteki. An 
Umamusume well-versed in ancient martial 
arts."

The beauty of their form, their steady 
breathing... Both were close to absolute 
perfection. And so, the two began their 
endless dance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hah! Seiya... hah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With flawless, unyielding coordination—we 
just have to see it through! The one left 
standing at the end is the victor!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "One, two! Three, four!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Yaeno-san is amazing~ She hasn't broken 
even a single drop of sweat~)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(This might be tough... But as the 
daughter of a dad who was a pro boxer, I 
won't give up!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One, two...! Three, four...!

Wonder Acute tenaciously hung in there 
with everything she had. Watching her, I 
couldn't help but—
choice_data_list: Win! You have to win, Acute!
Win it! You have to win, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer!? Thanks for the cheer. I... 
I...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna burn bright red past all my 
limits! Whoohoo!!

Throwing punches until all energy is 
exhausted. And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text: The victor is Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Um... Acute-san, are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Yaeno-san... I... Well, you 
see...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally burned out to pure white ash~ 
Hoyoyoyo~...

Even so, Wonder Acute, who gave it her all 
right until the very end, was met with 
warm applause—

And so, the Fan Appreciation Festival came 
to a close. Let's cross the Bridge of 
Tears on the way home.

Wonder Acute tenaciously hung in there. 
Watching Granny challenge the Unyielding 
Ancient Martial Arts King...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, fight! You can... you can still 
keep going!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You're not done yet! Acute! 
Acute!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: —Acute! Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (These... cheers are...?)

"Though tottering on her feet, Wonder 
Acute somehow managed to stay upright and 
continue her performance. Her dedication 
touched the hearts of everyone watching—"
And finally—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... *huff*... Can't... 
breathe...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it. Swaying her body that 
violently... and she still hasn't run out 
of breath...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I can't... even see anymore... My legs 
feel so heavy, but...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep goin'! One-two! One-two!

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text: Time's up! The winner is Wonder Acute!
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

A roar of applause. And the fans 
surrounding Wonder Acute.

Tossed around by the sea of people, I 
tried desperately to get closer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer~! Trainerrr~!

The excitement in the air reaches its 
absolute peak. Indeed, it is no longer a 
matter of winning or losing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I did it! I gave it everything I 
had~!

The echoing music wasâunmistakablyâa 
hymn to life for those who pushed 
themselves to their absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That was magnificent. Congratulations, 
Acute-san. But...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It feels like they're making a bit too 
much fuss. I thought this was just a light 
exhibition match, but...

And so, backed by numerous fans, Wonder 
Acute was crowned the World Champion(?) of 
Art Boxing.
